gwt.given: A caller builds a ShardsValues instance whose Shards collection is empty and passes it to ShardSetsBase<TConfiguration>.ShardSetReadAll.QueryAsync, for a shard set with no MockResults entry for query Q's name and a cancellation token that is not already cancelled.
gwt.then: no shard is queried and the call returns an empty list immediately, without touching the shard set.

sources.label: ReadQueryAllAsync MockResults short-circuit and upfront cancellation check that this scenario's "no MockResults entry" / "not already cancelled" preconditions name
